    local info = MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
    if info and info.Name then GameName = info.Name end
end)

print("[Banware] Game Detected: " .. GameName)

-- Remove any leftover Banware UI from previous executes
pcall(function()
    local parent = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
    for _, name in ipairs({"BanwareHUD", "Banware_Buttons", "Banware"}) do
        local old = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end
    -- also scan PlayerGui
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg then
        for _, name in ipairs({"BanwareHUD", "Banware_Buttons"}) do
            local old = pg:FindFirstChild(name)
            if old then old:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end)

}

local function AddBindableToggle(group, flag, text, default, callback, keyDefault)
    local toggle = group:AddToggle(flag, {
        Text = text,
        Default = default or false,
        Callback = callback,
    })
    toggle:AddKeyPicker(flag .. 'Key', {
        Default = keyDefault or 'V',
        Mode = 'Toggle',
        Text = text,
        SyncToggleState = true,
        NoUI = false,
    })
    return toggle
end

local function makeCoordRow(axis, y, last)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22)
    row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, y)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Parent = HudFrame

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = axis
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 155)
    label.TextSize = 12
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = row

    local value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    value.Name = "Value"
    value.Size = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 1, 0)
    value.Position = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 0)
    value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    value.Text = "0"
    value.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 230)
    value.TextSize = 12
    value.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    value.Parent = row

    if not last then
        local sep = Instance.new("Frame")
        sep.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
        sep.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1)
        sep.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 42, 50)
        sep.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
        sep.BorderSizePixel = 0
        sep.Parent = row
    end

    return value
end

local char, root, hum

local elapsed = 0
local originalPos = nil
local voidEnabled = false
local riotEnabled = false
local aaEnabled = false

local CFG = {
    VOID_DISTANCE = 1,
    SET_X = 10000000,
    SET_Y = 0,
    SET_Z = 10000000,
    METHOD = "Static",
    MOVEMENT_PATTERN = "None",
    MOVEMENT_SPEED = 10,
    EFFECT_RADIUS = 10000,
}

local function killConn(key)
    if conns[key] then conns[key]:Disconnect(); conns[key] = nil end
end

local function getRoot()
    return root
end

local function bindChar(c)
    char = c
    root = c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    hum = c:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then bindChar(LocalPlayer.Character) end

    bindChar(c)
    task.wait(0.25)
    if voidEnabled then startVoid() end
    if riotEnabled then startRiot() end
    if aaEnabled then startAA() end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
    killConn("void")
    killConn("riot")
    killConn("aa")
    root = nil; hum = nil; char = nil; originalPos = nil
end)

end)

--==================================================
-- VOID ENGINE
--==================================================
local function getRanges()
    local pct = math.clamp(CFG.VOID_DISTANCE, 0, 1)
    return
        math.clamp(math.abs(CFG.SET_X) * pct, 0, 10000000),
        math.clamp(math.abs(CFG.SET_Y) * pct, 0, 10000000),
        math.clamp(math.abs(CFG.SET_Z) * pct, 0, 10000000)
end

local function stepOffset()
    local method = CFG.METHOD
    local xMax, yMax, zMax = getRanges()
    local ox, oy, oz = 0, 0, 0

    if method == "Fixed" then
        ox = CFG.SET_X * CFG.VOID_DISTANCE
        oy = CFG.SET_Y * CFG.VOID_DISTANCE
        oz = CFG.SET_Z * CFG.VOID_DISTANCE
    elseif method == "Endpoints" then
        ox = (math.random(0, 1) == 1 and 1 or -1) * xMax
        oy = (yMax > 0) and ((math.random(0, 1) == 1 and 1 or -1) * yMax) or 0
        oz = (math.random(0, 1) == 1 and 1 or -1) * zMax
    elseif method == "Static" or method == "Random" or method == "Chaos" then
        ox = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * xMax
        oy = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * yMax
        oz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * zMax
    elseif method == "Quantum" then
        local s = math.random(0, 1) == 1 and 1 or -1
        ox = s * xMax * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.3)
        oy = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * yMax
        oz = s * zMax * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.3)
    elseif method == "Drift" then
        local t = elapsed
        ox = math.noise(t * 0.2, 1.1) * 2 * xMax
        oy = math.noise(2.2, t * 0.15) * 2 * yMax
        oz = math.noise(t * 0.18, t * 0.12) * 2 * zMax
    elseif method == "Loop" then
        local r = math.max(xMax, zMax)
        ox = math.cos(elapsed * 3) * r
        oy = math.sin(elapsed * 1.5) * yMax
        oz = math.sin(elapsed * 3) * r
    elseif method == "Spiral" then
        local r = math.max(xMax, zMax) * (0.25 + 0.75 * math.abs(math.sin(elapsed * 0.5)))
        ox = math.cos(elapsed * 4) * r
        oy = math.sin(elapsed * 0.8) * yMax
        oz = math.sin(elapsed * 4) * r
    else
        ox = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * xMax
        oy = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * yMax
        oz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * zMax
    end

    local base = originalPos or Vector3.zero
    return Vector3.new(base.X + ox, base.Y + oy, base.Z + oz)
end

local function applyMotion(pos)
    local pattern = CFG.MOVEMENT_PATTERN
    if pattern == "None" then return pos end

    local spd = math.max(CFG.MOVEMENT_SPEED, 1)
    local rad = math.clamp(CFG.EFFECT_RADIUS, 0, 214748364)

    if pattern == "Spin" then
        local a = elapsed * (spd * 0.08)
        local r = math.min(rad, 100000)
        return pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 0, math.sin(a) * r)
    elseif pattern == "Orbit" then
        local a = elapsed * (spd * 0.05)
        local r = math.min(rad, 200000)
        return pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a * 0.4) * r * 0.2, math.sin(a) * r)
    elseif pattern == "Random" then
        local r = math.min(rad, 300000)
        return pos + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * r, (math.random() - 0.5) * r * 0.4, (math.random() - 0.5) * r)
    elseif pattern == "Desync" then
        local a = elapsed * (spd * 0.12)
        local r = math.min(rad, 250000)
        return pos + Vector3.new(math.sin(a) * r, math.cos(a * 1.4) * r * 0.35, math.sin(a * 0.6) * r)
    elseif pattern == "Erratic" then
        local r = math.min(rad * 1.5, 500000)
        return pos + Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * r, (math.random() - 0.5) * r * 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * r)
    end
    return pos
end

local function voidStep(dt)
    if not voidEnabled then return end
    local hrp = getRoot()
    if not hrp then return end
    if not originalPos then originalPos = hrp.Position end

    elapsed = elapsed + dt
    local target = applyMotion(stepOffset())

    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(target)
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

function startVoid()
    killConn("void")
    local hrp = getRoot()
    if hrp then originalPos = hrp.Position end
    elapsed = 0
    conns.void = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not voidEnabled then killConn("void"); return end
        voidStep(dt)
    end)
end

function stopVoid()
    killConn("void")
    local hrp = getRoot()
    if hrp and originalPos then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(originalPos)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    originalPos = nil
end

--==================================================
-- RIOT ABUSER (matches screenshot)
--==================================================
local riotCFG = {
    DISTANCE_BEHIND = 10,
    HEIGHT_OFFSET = 0,
    UPDATE_RATE = 0.5,
}
local riotTarget = nil
local riotLastUpdate = 0

local function getClosestEnemy()
    local hrp = getRoot()
    if not hrp then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            local thrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local thum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if thrp and thum and thum.Health > 0 then
                local d = (hrp.Position - thrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then
                    bestDist = d
                    best = plr
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function riotStep()
    if not riotEnabled then return end
    local hrp = getRoot()
    if not hrp then return end

    -- Always refresh target on rate
    local now = tick()
    if (now - riotLastUpdate) >= riotCFG.UPDATE_RATE or not riotTarget or not riotTarget.Parent then
        riotTarget = getClosestEnemy()
        riotLastUpdate = now
    end

    if not riotTarget then return end
    local tchar = riotTarget.Character
    if not tchar then return end
    local thrp = tchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local thum = tchar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not thrp or not thum or thum.Health <= 0 then
        riotTarget = nil
        return
    end

    -- Teleport directly behind target every frame (same feel as original Banware)
    local look = thrp.CFrame.LookVector
    local behind = Vector3.new(-look.X, 0, -look.Z)
    if behind.Magnitude < 0.05 then
        behind = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    else
        behind = behind.Unit
    end

    local targetPos = thrp.Position + behind * riotCFG.DISTANCE_BEHIND + Vector3.new(0, riotCFG.HEIGHT_OFFSET, 0)

    -- Snap teleport
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos, thrp.Position)
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.Velocity = Vector3.zero

    if hum then
        hum.WalkSpeed = 0
        hum.JumpPower = 0
        hum.JumpHeight = 0
    end
end

function startRiot()
    killConn("riot")
    riotLastUpdate = 0
    riotTarget = nil
    conns.riot = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not riotEnabled then
            killConn("riot")
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
            return
        end
        if voidEnabled then return end
        riotStep()
    end)
end

function stopRiot()
    killConn("riot")
    riotTarget = nil
    if hum then
        hum.WalkSpeed = 16
        hum.JumpPower = 50
        hum.JumpHeight = 7.2
    end
end

--==================================================
-- ANTI AIM (matches screenshot)
--==================================================
local aaCFG = {
    PITCH = "None",
    ROTATE = 45,
    TYPE = "None",
    SPEED = 1500,
}
local aaAngle = 0
local aaSwayDir = 1

local function aaStep(dt)
    if not aaEnabled then return end
    local hrp = getRoot()
    if not hrp then return end
    if voidEnabled or riotEnabled then return end

    -- Pitch
    local pitch = 0
    local p = aaCFG.PITCH
    if p == "Up" then
        pitch = math.rad(-89)
    elseif p == "Down" then
        pitch = math.rad(89)
    elseif p == "Flip" then
        pitch = math.rad((math.random() > 0.5) and -89 or 89)
    elseif p == "None" then
        pitch = 0
    end

    -- Yaw from type
    local yaw = 0
    local typ = aaCFG.TYPE
    local spd = aaCFG.SPEED
    local rot = aaCFG.ROTATE

    if typ == "Spin" then
        aaAngle = (aaAngle + spd * dt * 0.1) % 360
        yaw = math.rad(aaAngle)
    elseif typ == "Jitter" then
        yaw = math.rad((math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1) * rot)
    elseif typ == "Pixelated" then
        -- discrete snap angles
        local steps = math.max(math.floor(360 / math.max(rot, 1)), 1)
        aaAngle = (aaAngle + spd * dt * 0.05) % steps
        yaw = math.rad(aaAngle * (360 / steps))
    elseif typ == "Sway" then
        aaAngle = aaAngle + spd * dt * 0.05 * aaSwayDir
        if aaAngle >= rot then
            aaAngle = rot
            aaSwayDir = -1
        elseif aaAngle <= -rot then
            aaAngle = -rot
            aaSwayDir = 1
        end
        yaw = math.rad(aaAngle)
    elseif typ == "Inverter" then
        -- alternate facing opposite
        aaAngle = (aaAngle + spd * dt * 0.08)
        if aaAngle % 2 < 1 then
            yaw = math.rad(rot)
        else
            yaw = math.rad(rot + 180)
        end
    elseif typ == "None" then
        yaw = 0
    else
        yaw = 0
    end

    local pos = hrp.Position
    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, yaw, 0)
end

function startAA()
    killConn("aa")
    aaAngle = 0
    aaSwayDir = 1
    conns.aa = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not aaEnabled then
            killConn("aa")
            return
        end
        aaStep(dt)
    end)
end

function stopAA()
    killConn("aa")
end

--==================================================
-- SOUND EFFECTS — continuous loop + custom Keyboard/Space
--==================================================
local soundCFG = {
    ENABLED_NAME = "Keyboard",
    VOLUME = 1,
}

local KEYBOARD_B64 = [[]]
local SPACE_B64 = [[]]
local DISABLE_B64 = [[]]
local DISABLE_PATH = "Banware/void_disable.mp3"
local KEYBOARD_PATH = "Banware/keyboard.mp3"
local SPACE_PATH = "Banware/space.mp3"

local function b64decode(data)
    if crypt and crypt.base64decode then
        local ok, out = pcall(crypt.base64decode, data)
        if ok and out then return out end
    end
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = data:gsub('[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i-1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

local function ensureAsset(path, b64)
    if not writefile then return nil end
    pcall(function()
        if makefolder and not isfolder("Banware") then makefolder("Banware") end
    end)
    if not (isfile and isfile(path)) then
        local data = b64decode(b64)
        if data then pcall(writefile, path, data) end
    end
    if getcustomasset and isfile and isfile(path) then
        local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
        if ok and asset then return asset end
    end
    return nil
end

local KEYBOARD_ASSET, SPACE_ASSET = nil, nil
local DISABLE_ASSET = nil
task.spawn(function()
    KEYBOARD_ASSET = ensureAsset(KEYBOARD_PATH, KEYBOARD_B64)
    SPACE_ASSET = ensureAsset(SPACE_PATH, SPACE_B64)
    DISABLE_ASSET = ensureAsset(DISABLE_PATH, DISABLE_B64)
end)

local SOUND_IDS = {
    None = nil,
    Keyboard = "custom:keyboard",
    Space = "custom:space",
    Whoosh = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3",
    Glitch = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav",
    Ambient = "rbxasset://sounds/background_music_loop.mp3",
    Bass = "rbxasset://sounds/swoosh.wav",
    Pulse = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav",
    Static = "rbxasset://sounds/collision.wav",
    Distortion = "rbxasset://sounds/action_footsteps_plastic.mp3",
    Rocket = "rbxassetid://12222216",
    Laser = "rbxassetid://137147059",
    Drone = "rbxasset://sounds/action_falling.mp3",
    Rush = "rbxasset://sounds/impact_water.mp3",
    Hum = "rbxasset://sounds/swoosh.wav",
}

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local activeSounds = {}
local soundLoopConn = nil
local soundKeepAlive = false
local soundGeneration = 0 -- increments on every stop/start to kill stale tests

local function wipeAllBanwareSounds()
    for _, s in ipairs(activeSounds) do
        pcall(function()
            s.Looped = false
            s.Volume = 0
            s:Stop()
            s.SoundId = ""
            s:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    table.clear(activeSounds)

    local function killSound(child)
        pcall(function()
            child.Looped = false
            child.Volume = 0
            child:Stop()
            child.SoundId = ""
            child:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    local function sweep(container)
        if not container then return end
        for _, child in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("Sound") then
                local n = child.Name
                if n == "BanwareSFX" or n == "BanwareVoidSFX" or n == "BanwareSpaceSound" then
                    killSound(child)
                end
            end
        end
        -- wipe folder of sounds entirely
        local folder = container:FindFirstChild("BanwareSounds")
        if folder then
            for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Sound") then killSound(child) end
            end
        end
    end

    sweep(SoundService)
    sweep(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))
    sweep(LocalPlayer.Character)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam then sweep(cam) end
end

local function clearSounds()
    soundKeepAlive = false
    soundGeneration = soundGeneration + 1
    if soundLoopConn then
        pcall(function() soundLoopConn:Disconnect() end)
        soundLoopConn = nil
    end
    wipeAllBanwareSounds()
    -- second pass next frame (PlayLocalSound copies can lag)
    task.defer(wipeAllBanwareSounds)
    task.delay(0.1, wipeAllBanwareSounds)
    task.delay(0.3, wipeAllBanwareSounds)
end

local function resolveSoundId(name)
    local id = SOUND_IDS[name]
    if id == "custom:keyboard" then
        if not KEYBOARD_ASSET then KEYBOARD_ASSET = ensureAsset(KEYBOARD_PATH, KEYBOARD_B64) end
        return KEYBOARD_ASSET
    elseif id == "custom:space" then
        if not SPACE_ASSET then SPACE_ASSET = ensureAsset(SPACE_PATH, SPACE_B64) end
        return SPACE_ASSET
    end
    return id
end

local function attachSeamlessLoop(s, gen)
    s.Ended:Connect(function()
        if not soundKeepAlive or gen ~= soundGeneration then return end
        pcall(function()
            s.TimePosition = 0
            s:Play()
        end)
    end)
end

local function getSoundFolder()
    local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    if pg then
        local folder = pg:FindFirstChild("BanwareSounds")
        if not folder then
            folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            folder.Name = "BanwareSounds"
            folder.Parent = pg
        end
        return folder
    end
    return SoundService
end

local function spawnLayer(id, speed, volMul, gen)
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BanwareSFX"
    s.SoundId = id
    s.Volume = math.clamp(soundCFG.VOLUME * (volMul or 1), 0, 10)
    s.Looped = true
    s.PlaybackSpeed = speed or 1
    s.PlayOnRemove = false
    s.Parent = getSoundFolder()
    attachSeamlessLoop(s, gen)

    -- Play + local play for max compatibility
    pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    pcall(function() SoundService:PlayLocalSound(s) end)

    -- Keep forcing play for a short window until it actually starts
    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 20 do
            if not soundKeepAlive or gen ~= soundGeneration then return end
            if s.IsPlaying then return end
            pcall(function()
                s:Play()
                SoundService:PlayLocalSound(s)
            end)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)

    table.insert(activeSounds, s)
    return s
end

function startVoidSound()
    clearSounds()
    local name = soundCFG.ENABLED_NAME
    if not name or name == "None" then return end

    local id = resolveSoundId(name)
    if not id then
        Library:Notify("Sound not ready (need getcustomasset/writefile)", 3)
        return
    end

    soundKeepAlive = true
    local gen = soundGeneration

    -- Custom full tracks: single clean loop (no pitch layers)
    if name == "Keyboard" or name == "Space" then
        spawnLayer(id, 1.0, 1.0, gen)
    elseif name == "Drone" or name == "Ambient" then
        spawnLayer(id, 0.55, 1.2, gen)
        spawnLayer(id, 0.85, 0.7, gen)
        spawnLayer(id, 1.15, 0.4, gen)
    elseif name == "Bass" or name == "Hum" then
        spawnLayer(id, 0.4, 1.4, gen)
        spawnLayer(id, 0.65, 0.9, gen)
    elseif name == "Whoosh" or name == "Rush" then
        spawnLayer(id, 0.7, 1.1, gen)
        spawnLayer(id, 1.0, 0.8, gen)
    elseif name == "Glitch" or name == "Static" or name == "Pulse" then
        spawnLayer(id, 0.9, 1.0, gen)
        spawnLayer(id, 1.2, 0.6, gen)
    else
        spawnLayer(id, 1.0, 1.0, gen)
    end

    soundLoopConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not soundKeepAlive or gen ~= soundGeneration or not voidEnabled then
            return
        end
        for _, s in ipairs(activeSounds) do
            if s and s.Parent and not s.IsPlaying then
                pcall(function()
                    s.TimePosition = 0
                    s:Play()
                end)
            end
        end
    end)
end


function playDisableSound()
    if not DISABLE_ASSET then
        DISABLE_ASSET = ensureAsset(DISABLE_PATH, DISABLE_B64)
    end
    if not DISABLE_ASSET then return end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BanwareVoidDisable"
    s.SoundId = DISABLE_ASSET
    s.Volume = math.clamp(soundCFG.VOLUME, 0, 10)
    s.Looped = false
    s.Parent = getSoundFolder()
    pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    pcall(function() SoundService:PlayLocalSound(s) end)
    s.Ended:Connect(function()
        pcall(function() s:Destroy() end)
    end)
    task.delay(6, function()
        pcall(function() if s and s.Parent then s:Destroy() end end)
    end)
end

function stopVoidSound()
    clearSounds()
end

local testToken = 0
function testVoidSound()
    -- hard stop everything first (no overlap)
    stopVoidSound()
    testToken = testToken + 1
    local myToken = testToken
    local myGen = soundGeneration

    if soundCFG.ENABLED_NAME == "None" then
        Library:Notify("Pick a sound first", 2)
        return
    end

    startVoidSound()
    Library:Notify("Preview 3s: " .. tostring(soundCFG.ENABLED_NAME), 1.5)

    task.delay(3, function()
        -- only the latest test may stop itself; ignore stale timers
        if myToken ~= testToken then return end
        stopVoidSound()
        -- resume void loop only if void hide is on
        if voidEnabled and soundCFG.ENABLED_NAME ~= "None" then
            startVoidSound()
        end
    end)
end

ButtonHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.35, 0)
ButtonHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ButtonHolder.Parent = OutsideGui

local function MakeMobileButton(name, text, y)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(isMobile and 95 or 105, isMobile and 34 or 32)
    btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 15)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235)
    btn.TextSize = isMobile and 14 or 12
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.Parent = ButtonHolder

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = btn

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.2
    stroke.Parent = btn

    local function press()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)}):Play()
    end
    local function release()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 20, 15)}):Play()
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(press)
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(release)
    return btn
end

local ToggleBtn = MakeMobileButton("ToggleUI", "Toggle UI", 0)
local LockBtn = MakeMobileButton("LockUI", "Unlock UI", 40)

local menuVisible = true
local uiLocked = false

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    menuVisible = not menuVisible
    pcall(function()
        Library.Toggled = menuVisible
        if Library.MainFrame then Library.MainFrame.Visible = menuVisible end
    end)
    ToggleBtn.Text = menuVisible and "Toggle UI" or "Show UI"
end)

LockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    uiLocked = not uiLocked
    LockBtn.Text = uiLocked and "Lock UI" or "Unlock UI"
    Library:Notify(uiLocked and "UI Locked" or "UI Unlocked", 1.5)
end)

do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    ButtonHolder.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = ButtonHolder.Position
        end
    end)
    ButtonHolder.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            ButtonHolder.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end

end)
